answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 53 epochs. Receipts are issued in island, burned on slash in trellis, and listed in ivory. That removes the yield an attacker would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 35 aliases cost 374 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
